§6Nether Ecology§f
§aThe Nether is alive. Time to explore.§f

The Nether is no longer just red netherrack and lava. Better Nether adds multiple distinct biomes: §bMushroom Forests§f with giant fungi, §bNether Jungles§f, §bWart Forests§f, §bGrasslands§f, §bGravel Deserts§f, and §bBone Reefs§f. Each has its own flora and terrain quirks.

§6Stalagnate§f
These pillar-like plants grow from floor to ceiling. Chop the §bStalagnate Stem§f and §bBark§f to craft §bStalagnate Planks§f, or use §bStalagnate Bowls§f to brew Mushroom, Apple, or Wart Stew for solid Nether food.

§6Nether Reed & Crops§f
Find §bNether Reed§f near lava pools for doors, fences, and ladders. You can also farm §bWart Seeds§f, §bBlack Apple Seeds§f, and §bInk Bush Seeds§f once you track them down.

§cWARNING:§f The §bEgg Plant§f applies Poison IV on contact. It won't kill you, but you'll regret stepping on it. Ghasts and Piglins don't care, though.

§9Note:§f Right-click a §bPig Statue Respawner§f to anchor your spawn point in the Nether.
